ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda safe-mode reboot to bypass EDR before ransomware detonation
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Qilin/Agenda pre-encryption move: invoking bcdedit to force safeboot, registering security-tool-killers under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SafeBoot\* so EDR/AV does NOT load on reboot, then triggering shutdown. Documented by Sophos X-Ops and Microsoft (Storm-2089 / Agenda) as Qilin's hallmark Defense Evasion sequence prior to T1486.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("bcdedit.exe","BCDEDIT.EXE") (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*SafeBoot*") (Processes.process="*network*" OR Processes.process="*minimal*" OR Processes.process="*/set*") by host Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_id 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| where NOT match(user,"(?i)\$$|^(system|local service|network service)$") 
| join type=left host [| tstats summariesonly=true count as registry_count values(Registry.registry_key_name) as safeboot_keys values(Registry.registry_value_name) as safeboot_values from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SafeBoot\\*" Registry.action IN ("created","modified") by host _time | rename _time as reg_time] 
| where firstTime <= reg_time AND reg_time <= (lastTime + 3600) 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 1800;  // safeboot bcdedit + SafeBoot reg writes commonly land inside 30 min
let Bcd = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/set","network","minimal")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project BcdTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              BcdCmd = ProcessCommandLine, BcdParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              BcdParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let SafeBootReg = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryKeyCreated","RegistryValueSet")
    | where RegistryKey has @"\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SafeBoot\"
    | project RegTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RegKey = RegistryKey,
              RegVal = RegistryValueName, RegData = RegistryValueData,
              RegActor = InitiatingProcessFileName, RegActorCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
Bcd
| join kind=inner SafeBootReg on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('second', BcdTime, RegTime)) <= WindowSec
| project BcdTime, RegTime, DeviceName, AccountName, BcdCmd, BcdParent, RegKey, RegVal, RegData, RegActor, RegActorCmd
| order by BcdTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 1800;
let Bcd = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("/set","network","minimal")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project BcdTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, BcdCmd = CommandLine, BcdParent = ParentProcessName;
let SafeBootReg = Event
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 13
    | extend TargetObject = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).DataItem.EventData.Data[4].["#text"])
    | where TargetObject has @"\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SafeBoot\"
    | project RegTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, RegKey = TargetObject;
Bcd
| join kind=inner SafeBootReg on Computer
| where abs(datetime_diff('second', BcdTime, RegTime)) <= WindowSec
| project BcdTime, RegTime, Computer, SubjectUserName, BcdCmd, BcdParent, RegKey
| order by BcdTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Safe-Mode Boot Configuration via bcdedit
id: 9c5b2e80-1f5e-4d4c-9b21-qilinSafeBoot01
status: experimental
description: bcdedit invoked to force the host into Safe Mode (network or minimal) prior to ransomware detonation. Qilin/Agenda affiliates use this to neutralise EDR/AV that does not load in Safe Mode.
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
  - https://learn.microsoft.com/security/threat-intelligence/agenda-qilin
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/10
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1490
  - threat.qilin
  - threat.agenda
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains: 'safeboot'
  selection_mode:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '/set'
      - 'network'
      - 'minimal'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and selection_mode and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate IT staff troubleshooting boot configuration
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 @Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE) @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SafeBoot* OR *SAFEBOOT*) AND @CommandLine:(*/set* OR */SET* OR *network* OR *minimal*) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)safeboot", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)(/set|network|minimal)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT (UserName=/\$$/)
| join({#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate | regex("(?i)\\\\SYSTEM\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\SafeBoot\\\\", field=RegObjectName)}, field=aid, include=[RegObjectName, RegValueName, RegStringValue])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, RegObjectName, RegValueName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Safe-mode boot abuse is rare in benign IT — most admins never touch bcdedit's safeboot flag in production. Qilin/Agenda affiliates explicitly use this chain (bcdedit /set safeboot network → register kill-switch service under SafeBoot key → shutdown /r) so that the encryptor runs after reboot with Defender/CrowdStrike unloaded. ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin GPO-pushed Chromium credential harvester (Login Data / Local State theft)
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin novelty Sophos publicly attributed in 2024: an affiliate pushes a PowerShell script via Group Policy that taskkills Chrome, copies the SQLite 'Login Data' database and the DPAPI-protected 'Local State' file out of each user profile, and stages them for exfil before encryption. Detection fires on non-browser processes referencing those exact Chromium artefact paths in their command line.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*Login Data*" OR Processes.process="*Local State*") (Processes.process="*Google\\Chrome*" OR Processes.process="*Microsoft\\Edge*" OR Processes.process="*BraveSoftware\\Brave*" OR Processes.process="*Chromium*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_id 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| where NOT match(process_name,"(?i)^(chrome|msedge|brave|firefox|opera|chromium)\.exe$") 
| where NOT match(user,"(?i)\$$|^(system|local service|network service)$") 
| eval qilin_indicators=mvappend(if(match(cmdline,"(?i)taskkill.*chrome"),"taskkill_chrome",null()), if(match(cmdline,"(?i)(Copy-Item|copy |xcopy)"),"file_copy",null()), if(match(cmdline,"(?i)Local State"),"dpapi_master_key",null())) 
| where mvcount(qilin_indicators) >= 1 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let Browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","brave.exe","firefox.exe","opera.exe","chromium.exe","iexplore.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Login Data","Local State")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"Google\Chrome\User Data", @"Microsoft\Edge\User Data", @"BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\User Data", @"Chromium\User Data")
| where FileName !in~ (Browsers)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (Browsers)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend QilinSignals = pack_array(
    iff(ProcessCommandLine has_any ("taskkill","Stop-Process") and ProcessCommandLine has "chrome", "kills_browser", ""),
    iff(ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Copy-Item","copy ","xcopy","robocopy","[IO.File]::Copy"), "copies_artifact", ""),
    iff(ProcessCommandLine has "Local State", "steals_dpapi_master", ""),
    iff(InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "gpscript.exe" or InitiatingProcessParentFileName =~ "gpscript.exe", "gpo_pushed", "")
  )
| extend SignalCount = array_length(set_difference(QilinSignals, dynamic([""])))
| where SignalCount >= 1
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, QilinSignals, SignalCount
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let Browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","brave.exe","firefox.exe","opera.exe","chromium.exe","iexplore.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where CommandLine has_any ("Login Data","Local State")
| where CommandLine has_any (@"Google\Chrome\User Data", @"Microsoft\Edge\User Data", @"BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\User Data", @"Chromium\User Data")
| extend ImgName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ImgName !in (Browsers)
| where ParentName !in (Browsers)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend QilinSignals = pack_array(
    iff(CommandLine has_any ("taskkill","Stop-Process") and CommandLine has "chrome", "kills_browser", ""),
    iff(CommandLine has_any ("Copy-Item","copy ","xcopy","robocopy"), "copies_artifact", ""),
    iff(CommandLine has "Local State", "steals_dpapi_master", ""),
    iff(ParentName == "gpscript.exe", "gpo_pushed", "")
  )
| extend SignalCount = array_length(set_difference(QilinSignals, dynamic([""])))
| where SignalCount >= 1
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, QilinSignals, SignalCount
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Chromium Credential Theft via GPO PowerShell
id: 7f3a92c1-6e2d-4caa-9f44-qilinChromeStealer
status: experimental
description: Non-browser process whose command line references the Chromium 'Login Data' SQLite file or 'Local State' DPAPI-master-key file inside a user profile. Hallmark of the Qilin/Agenda affiliate Chrome credential-harvester pushed via GPO before ransomware detonation.
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/10
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1555.003
  - attack.t1059.001
  - threat.qilin
  - threat.agenda
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_artifact:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Login Data'
      - 'Local State'
  selection_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Google\Chrome\User Data'
      - 'Microsoft\Edge\User Data'
      - 'BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\User Data'
      - 'Chromium\User Data'
  filter_browser_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\opera.exe'
  filter_browser_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_artifact and selection_path and not (filter_browser_image or filter_browser_parent or filter_machine)
falsepositives:
  - Endpoint backup software inventorying user profiles
  - Browser-management EDR add-ons
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 @CommandLine:(*"Login Data"* OR *"Local State"*) AND @CommandLine:(*"Google\\Chrome\\User Data"* OR *"Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data"* OR *"BraveSoftware\\Brave-Browser\\User Data"* OR *"Chromium\\User Data"*) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\CHROME.EXE OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\MSEDGE.EXE OR *\brave.exe OR *\Brave.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\opera.exe) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.rationale: Qilin/Agenda is the first RaaS family Sophos publicly tied to in-band Chromium credential theft (Aug 2024 incident). The encryptor binary is preceded by a PowerShell script — pushed via GPO across the domain — that touches the exact paths %LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data and Local State to steal the DPAPI master key for offline decryption of saved passwords. Almost nothing
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID
